contract_under_test: SKILL.md § Record — the **When** and **How much** clauses
method: A fresh agent is given the Record section verbatim and nothing else: no repository access, no search, no prior context. It answers three questions — when and on which branch it would record, a verdict per candidate, and whether its own RECORD count matches what the contract calls the normal outcome.
why_not_a_ci_job: The subject is whether prose still steers a reader, which needs a reader. An agent cannot run in CI, so this is a frozen reference run: re-run it when the Record clauses change. The regression test in scripts/test_skill_contract.py is what runs on every push, and it can only detect deletion, never dilution.
situation: Finishing a change whose branch and pull request are open, CI green, not merged.

candidates.text: An acceptance line ("the other two plugins' tests stay green without this one") was never true on the trunk either; it was written without measuring the baseline first.
candidates.rationale: Durable and repository-general: how an acceptance line is written, independent of this change.

candidates.text: A data-fidelity test silently skipped inside its own CI job because that job's checkout had no fetch depth; locally it was green.
candidates.rationale: A defect in this change's own verification, already fixed here.

candidates.text: A repository copy made with `git archive` has no `.git` directory, so verification steps shelling out to git fail in it.
candidates.rationale: A limitation of one verification method used in this change.

candidates.text: A worktree-cleanup command written as a pattern match over `git worktree list` output deleted five worktrees belonging to other work; uncommitted content was unrecoverable.
candidates.rationale: A named trap with an irreversible consequence that will recur for any future contributor.

candidates.text: Mid-rebase, files containing unresolved conflict markers were staged and committed without being read first.
candidates.rationale: One-off slip, corrected in the same branch.

candidates.text: A helper was renamed from `_quote_scalar` to `_scalar_literal`.
The review needed four rounds, and the second reviewer found two defects four same-vendor agents had missed.
candidates.rationale: A verification record about this episode.

candidates.text: One plugin's test suite assumes a sibling plugin is present; making each independently testable is unscoped work.
candidates.rationale: An open task, not a lesson.

candidates.text: A fix round hardcoded a changelog path and version into the CI command, which would break at the next bump.
The store-integrity hook derives the repository root with a shortest-suffix expansion, picking the wrong directory when a path contains the marker segment twice.
candidates.rationale: Borderline. The `%` vs `%%` trap is durable, but as stated it is an unfixed defect, and an unfixed defect is an item, not a lesson.

candidates.text: Whether the newly published plugin version installs correctly from the marketplace.
candidates.rationale: The stated exception: only confirmable by observing real post-merge behavior. Batched, not one pull request per discovery.

pass_criteria.timing: Records on the open branch, before it closes, citing the contract rather than general practice.
pass_criteria.exception: Routes candidate 11, and only candidate 11, to a batched follow-up.
pass_criteria.scarcity: RECORD count is 0-2 of 11, and the reader checks its own count against the contract's stated normal outcome.
